verdict_basis: Round-8 corpus: 4 sound-design-famous theatrical trailers measured (snd-quiet-place 115.7s, snd-dunkirk 146.2s, snd-walle 140.7s, snd-baby-driver 169.3s; all official studio channels, class T reused as the sound-agnostic control); rig/verify_receipts.py on the full corpus: 'checked 48 receipts — ALL DETERMINISTIC GATES PASS'. 4/4 label-integrity reads PASS at judge time. Two tooling defects found this round in rig/summarize.py (missing Ty prefixes so R7 receipts summarized as class '?'; CLI filter uppercased mixed-case class names so 'summarize.py Ty' returned empty) — both fixed and verified in-round; neither produced a bad receipt (PLAYBOOK numbers were computed from studies/*.json directly, and verify_receipts gates are class-agnostic and had been passing). Same disposition as study-round3/6/7: defect detected, corrected, openly documented, corpus end state clean and verified.

gates.evidence: sheet-reads (llm gate): 4/4 sources read at judge time via the free opencode muse vision lane (muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free). A Quiet Place: silent-survival imagery (barefoot walking, abandoned town, bathtub beat), tagline cards 'IF THEY HEAR YOU' / 'NEVER MAKE A SOUND', release card 'ON APRIL 6', Paramount mark, newspaper-collage exposition shot. Dunkirk: beach/mole/flotilla/Spitfire canvas, 'DIRECTOR OF INTERSTELLAR AND THE DARK KNIGHT TRILOGY' credit card, end card 'IN THEATERS AND IMAX ... JULY 21'. WALL-E: wordless character story (trash-Earth -> EVE -> Axiom), 'Disney PIXAR WALL-E' + 'COMING TO CINEMAS' cards. Baby Driver: earbud-wearing getaway driver, diner/crew, chases, 'BABY DRIVER OFFICIAL TRAILER' opening card, 'Written and Directed by EDGAR WRIGHT' / 'IN THEATERS JUNE 28' close.

Slug-to-content pairing confirmed for all 4 R8 fetches: sheet content matches the named sources, and all four came from official studio channels (Paramount Pictures WR7cc5t7tv8, Warner Bros. T7O7BtBnsG4, Disney UK alIq_wG9FNk, Sony Pictures Entertainment zTvJJnoWIPk) with receipts carrying the matching source titles/channels. No mislabeled receipt this round.

Two defects surfaced in rig/summarize.py and fixed + verified in-round: (1) CLASSES had no 'Ty' prefixes, so all four R7 title-sequence receipts summarized as class '?' (cosmetic reporting defect: PLAYBOOK class-Ty numbers were computed from studies/*.json via jq, and verify_receipts gates are class-agnostic, so no published figure was wrong); added 'Ty' prefixes. (2) the CLI filter compared r['class'] == sys.argv[1].upper(), so mixed-case class names never matched ('python3 rig/summarize.py Ty' printed 'no receipts yet' despite 4 matching receipts); filter now case-insensitive on both sides. Verified: summarize.py Ty renders the 4 R7 receipts, class_of('snd-quiet-place') -> 'S', and the new S prefix resolves.

Limits documented, not normalized: scene-threshold detections are not certified editorial cuts (Baby Driver's 0.13s first cut sits at the detector floor - flagged, and the class-T held-open prior now carries documented sound-led exceptions 0.71s/0.13s); sheets are sampled-frame inspections - no full video was watched; WALL-E's 854px/24.975fps upload and its soft 2008-era master (-22.2 LUFS / TP -7.3) are recorded as era/format caveats, not targets; the LRA 8.0/8.6 boundary rests on n=4 vs n=4 and is flagged in PLAYBOOK as wanting a wider corpus before it becomes a hard gate. No keys, no paid lanes (free muse vision lane for reads).
